When an experimental group of an AB test wins and goes online, in order to observe the long\-term benefits and effects of the group's strategies/functions, a part of the traffic will be drawn into the control group (no new strategies/functions have been experienced) and then an AB test \- that is, "backtest experiment", through this backtest experiment to track and observe the changes of its core indicators for a long time. This article shows you how to start a backtest experiment on DataTester.

<span id="e7721f85"></span>
# Background information

With the rapid iteration of business, the observation time of AB test is limited, and it is often released to the general public after the positive conclusion is verified by short\-term experiments. However, the positive results in the short term are not enough to evaluate the long\-term benefits. Therefore, the "backtest experiment" has increasingly become a necessary part of AB test evaluation. It can be used to observe whether the improvement of key indicators is still in line with expectations and whether it will bring other negative effects after the important functions/strategies are launched. It is recommended that all experiments be rolled out 100% open a small flow reversal.

When the backtest experiment is held on DataTester, the control group traffic of the original experiment that has ended will be hashed again, and the traffic of this part will be evenly distributed, and then allocated to the experimental group and control group of the backtest experiment according to the traffic ratio of the backtest experiment configuration, as the actual effective traffic, as shown in the figure below.

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<span id="e7d4d303"></span>
# Usage restrictions


* Privatized 4.9.2 version now supports backtest experiments.

* The condition for the backtest experiment to start requires that the original experiment must have ended.

* Currently, backtest experiments only support client\-side programming experiments.

* Parent\-child experiments, experiments that use "user grouping" in "user audience rules" do not support conducting backtest experiments.


<span id="32fc554c"></span>
# Create a backtest experiment


1. Experiment details → Top navigation → Create a backtest experiment

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/15c557b3f70e414bb367900657bf2f92~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   Configure the experimental parameters of the backtest experiment in the popup interface.

2. Configure basic information.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b554926c6d9d463383fe24090ebdc655~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   
   |Parameter |Configuration instructions |
   |---|---|
   |**Name of experiment** |By default, "\-backtest experiment" will be added after the original experiment name as the name of the experiment, and modification is supported. |
   |**Experimental label** |By default, the [backtest experiment] tag will be added to support modification. |
   |**Type of experiment** |Same as the original experiment, cannot be modified |
   

3. Configure the effective policy.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/0d23dc3beae143889ab44ccc5be4e032~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   
   |Parameter |Configuration instructions |
   |---|---|
   |**Experimental traffic** |You can choose according to the selection of the traffic layer. |
   |**User audience rules** |It is recommended to configure audience rules consistent with the original experiment. |
   

4. Configure the experimental version.

   1. Configure experimental version parameters.

      The parameter configuration grey out of the experiment cannot be modified. The default control and experimental version configurations are the same as the original experiment and can be adjusted as needed

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b30e9710b66e4dbbbbbb72051ccb7b97~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   2. Configure experimental version traffic.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/3d9bb09e572b4e27968b21a2d938bcbc~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

      * **The actual effective flow rate of the original experimental control group:**  that is, the actual flow rate of the experimental control group in the original experiment.

      * **Experimental traffic:**  that is, the traffic layer selected in the above steps, or the traffic layer created by default, the proportion of traffic in the traffic layer used.

      * **Traffic distribution ratio:**  that is, the traffic distribution ratio between the experimental version and the control version of the backtest experiment configured here, the default is uniform traffic distribution (that is, the experimental version and the control version are evenly distributed). After closing the uniform distribution button in the upper right corner, you can manually set the traffic ratio of each version.

      * **Actual effective traffic:**  Refers to how much online traffic will actually hit a version of the backtest experiment. The numerical calculation formula is as follows:

         \*\*Actual effective flow \*\*= **actual effective flow of the original experimental control group** \* **experimental flow** \* **flow distribution ratio**

5. Add experimental metrics.

   The default focus is the indicator of the original experimental focus, which can be adjusted as needed.
